reviews.review_text: Noah and Carlos were the BEST hosts. We had a ball! We were celebrating our twin birthday and they made us feel like celebrities! The rain couldn’t even dampen our spirits. We will definitely be back! Thank you so much for making our night memorable and making us both feel so special!

Was recommended this semi hidden gem on the water. It was the perfect place for a night out with a friend or a date! The food was delish, the drinks were strong and you can tell the employees love their job. Everyone from the kitchen staff to the bartenders had warm smiles and were eager to help. The views are beautiful and I would 10/10 recommend! The ramp leading to the ship is a lil choppy due to the water so prepare yourself if you are someone who experiences motion sickness.

evidence: The food was delish, the drinks were strong and you can tell the employees love their job.

reviews.review_text: This is a beautiful spot to get drinks and food with friends. This is was my second time going here. The first time I came for a birthday party while this time it was just a get-together with friends. The scenery is amazing. The food and drink options are also pretty good. You don't have to worry about splitting checks if you don't want to because everyone can order their food and drinks separately and bring them back to the table. My party of 3 did a walk-in on a busy Saturday afternoon and was seated within 10 minutes. Reservations are not required but I would definitely recommend making one if coming in the evening on a weekend because a lot of private events happen. The Saturday we went they closed at 6pm for a private event. So it's good to know if the place is open or how many seats are available. Overall would definitely recommend to stop by with friends for drinks and good vibes this summer.

EDIT: Check your credit card statement! An 18% mystery charge was added after the initial purchase though one was not authorized when payment was made. Contacted establishment via email as there’s no phone number listed and never received a response.

Former “World’s Smallest Aircraft Carrier” turned outdoor bar and grill. Amazing views, good menu. The shrimp tacos were delicious, but very small. The sweet potato fries were good and a nice portion. Casual, cool vibe—but a bit too loud.

evidence: The shrimp tacos were delicious, but very small.

Cool experience. Order drinks and food at the bar. You get a buzzer to pick up your food at the window when it is ready. It was crowded and there was a birthday party event happening when we went. I recommend a reservation if you can! Especially for sunset.

The fish taco and lobster toll and hot dog were great. I won't order the calamari again but it wasn't bad, it wasn't spicy and just didn't seem worth it.

reviews.review_text: Updated review: Extremely loud environment during recent visits and no response from staff or management about adjusting the volume just a little; unable to tolerate the painfully noisy environment anymore. Our table was unable to converse on a Sunday afternoon, other guests in our party complained about the extremely loud music, overall a bad experience and disappointed we can’t go back because it’s otherwise a great establishment. Original review: Lovely atmosphere, friendly staff, and food is decent. Excellent handling of a surprise summer storm; they instantly moved the party below deck and made the experience even more fun for us than usual.

Playlist was perfect. There are 4 restrooms/stalls. Two on each level. Decent selection of bar food. If you go in the cooler months like spring and fall, your food will get cold quick due to the sea breeze. Slight smell of garbage every once in awhile.

evidence: Decent selection of bar food.

reviews.review_text: Nice place with an amazing view. Friendly staff, good food and drinks. Love the laidback vibe. Will definitely return

evidence: Friendly staff, good food and drinks.

reviews.review_text: Went yesterday as the sun was setting and the view was spectacular. This place is good for groups or couples. Great vibes. Everyone was very friendly. The drink (i had the mule) was perfectly made and delicious. The food was nothing fancy, finger foods, but was good nonetheless. Reservations highly recommended. This is going to be my summer spot.

evidence: The drink (i had the mule) was perfectly made and delicious.

reviews.review_text: Come see the amazing views on the Hudson River. This is an amazing location that I absolutely recommend to anyone here in the city. It is a unique experience to wine and dine on a military vessel. The food is delicious and the drinks are always strong. The bartenders are friendly and quick! I always bring friends here and they love the views and service from the staff. I even did a wedding rehearsal here once. My family and friends loved it. It was scenic and very memorable for everyone.

evidence: The food is delicious and the drinks are always strong.

reviews.review_text:
The Baylander is such a vibe. First off- it’s a ship! Some slight rocking but that’s to be expected- it’s on the water and the tunes don’t disappoint if you feel like rocking simultaneously.
It’s right on the west side highway perfectly perched on the 125th street pier.
The environment is very welcoming. A perfect place for drinks after work or for a nice date with that special someone. You can even pull up on a jet ski or boat for a quick meal. I truly enjoyed my time here.
The food is great! I had the Harlem Lobster Roll- the meat was big, juicy, and tasty. I paired it with some crispy fries and a Damn The Torpedoes cocktail.
So peeps- Make your way to the Baylander for an awesome time I definitely recommend this establishment.

evidence: I paired it with some crispy fries and a Damn The Torpedoes cocktail.

reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of experiencing brunch at Baylander and it was absolutely fantastic! The location right on the Hudson River is simply breathtaking, offering stunning views that enhance the dining experience. The atmosphere was perfect, with just the right amount of music playing in the background, creating a lively yet relaxing ambiance.

The cocktails at Baylander were exceptional. They were expertly crafted and delicious, perfectly complementing the mouthwatering food that was served. Every bite was a delight, with a wide variety of options to choose from and each dish bursting with flavor. The menu catered to different tastes and dietary preferences, ensuring that everyone could find something to enjoy.

What made the experience even more enjoyable was the pleasant weather and the cooling breeze from the river. It provided a refreshing escape from the heat, allowing me to fully savor the meal and the beautiful surroundings.

One of the things I appreciated about Baylander was that it wasn't overly crowded. I could truly relax and enjoy my brunch without feeling rushed or overwhelmed. It's clear that this hidden gem has yet to be fully discovered, and if it were located downtown, I have no doubt it would be packed.

Overall, Baylander is a great spot for brunch. The stunning location, delicious food, great cocktails, and welcoming atmosphere make it a standout choice. I'm already looking forward to my next visit and I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a memorable brunch experience.

reviews.review_text: We didn't eat or go on the ship. We just sat by the water. I don't want to give it a rating until I try it. By the water was great. The weather was nice, the mood was great...overall it was a fantastic night.

Was biking by with a group and wanted to visit, but was told we couldn't bring our bikes up with us. Unfortunately leaving road bikes down on the pier is not a good option.

The restaurant wasn't close to full and there was plenty of space, so not totally sure what the issue was.

Would love if they reconsider this policy! I'd visit all the time.

It's beautiful to see that my neighborhood can enjoy the same things as those who live below 96 Street. I went on a Wednesday, and they had a private party but were opening up for the public at 3:15pm. Hostess was very informative. Told us how to order, where to pick up, and also where the restroom was. The maintenance staff were on point, a napkins fell, and they were right there to pick it up. I had the pretzels, and it was so soft and delicious. The sauces are one cheese and the other mustard. It was wonderful to know they have mocktails and non-alcoholic beer. Will definitely return loved the sun and feeling the waves.

evidence: It was wonderful to know they have mocktails and non-alcoholic beer.

reviews.review_text: The Baylander is all about Hudson breezes, sunset views, and a really unusual boating experience. Food was okay: pretty good lobster roll, nice corn/elote, ok veggie burger, yummy sweet potato fries. Skip the shrimp tacos, Brussels sprouts with chimichurri (description sounded promising) and lemonade. Can't imagine how strong their cocktails are for these prices but the ambiance is... As they say .. priceless.
